736982.name: Screaming Generative AI Fail "I'm afraid of monsters" (looplicator input)
736982.description: The last bits of organic matter screaming in agony over the threshold from the abyss they just were dragged into. An AI illegally fed by every easily reachable audiobook in existence by the passageway conveniently translates the shriek in a soulless matter-of-fact tone. That was fun to write. Let's see what pictures generative AI (SD 2.1-768, 2x batch of 2) creates based on that: Okay then. The "creation" of this sound was inspired by Scpsea's "I'm afraid of monsters", I too used Kikirilkov/Voice_Cloning (which apparently in turn uses jbetker/tortoise-tts-v2) using the following sound under CC-BY 4.0: 148 BPM Industrial Drum Loop #375 (WAV) by looplicator and the text "I'm afraid of monsters" as input. I picked "pl" language for funsies. Processing took about 60 seconds. Attribution required for both qubodup and looplicator. No idea if that is enforcable or makes sense by any means but if you don't like that, simply grab a CC0 sound, visit the Voice Cloning link above and make one. <3
